app_user_contact_chk.name: app_user_contact_chk
app_user_contact_chk.value: "app_user"."phone" is not null or "app_user"."email" is not null

payment_two_person_chk.name: payment_two_person_chk
payment_two_person_chk.value: "payment"."confirmed_by_user_id" is null or "payment"."recorded_by_user_id" is null or "payment"."confirmed_by_user_id" <> "payment"."recorded_by_user_id"

refund_two_person_chk.name: refund_two_person_chk
refund_two_person_chk.value: "refund"."confirmed_by_user_id" is null or "refund"."initiated_by_user_id" is null or "refund"."confirmed_by_user_id" <> "refund"."initiated_by_user_id"

refund_approval_two_person_chk.name: refund_approval_two_person_chk
refund_approval_two_person_chk.value: "refund"."approved_by_user_id" is null or "refund"."initiated_by_user_id" is null or "refund"."approved_by_user_id" <> "refund"."initiated_by_user_id"

refund_method_details_chk.name: refund_method_details_chk
refund_method_details_chk.value:
("refund"."method"::text = 'GATEWAY' and "refund"."payment_id" is not null and "refund"."gateway_refund_id" is not null)
        or ("refund"."method"::text <> 'GATEWAY' and "refund"."reference" is not null and "refund"."paid_on" is not null)
